end.parentNote: Asha practised naming equal shares and finding one-third of a collection by making equal groups. Nisha correctly identified quarters in equal sections and later corrected the mix-up between the number of groups and the number of items: one-third of 15 is 5. At home, practise one-half and one-third with small groups of objects, asking how many equal groups there are and how many items are in one group.
